sections.title: 11. Disparities and Vulnerable Populations
key_points: Heart failure in non-Caucasians, women, and older adults is addressed in a white paper on special populations.
Heart disease and stroke statistics report highlights disparities.
National differences are observed in trends for heart failure hospitalizations by sex and race/ethnicity.
The complexity of heart failure risk and treatment is emphasized.
Structural racism and access to healthcare are significant factors in heart failure management.
